text_block_list.text:
One day. Stepping into the library, I found 
Win Variation deep in a book. 
The title was...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
This? Well... I've been wanting to get better 
at turning the murky feelings into strength. 
So I'm studying up on the mental side.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It's just, there are so many different methods 
that I can't tell which one is right...
choice_data_list: Then let's try them together and find a good one

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Really? 
Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
First, deep breathing, to settle the nerves. 
Apparently it works better if you picture 
something pleasant as you breathe in.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Let me see... 
Freshly picked apples, all crisp and juicy?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
A vast apple orchard... with the harvest 
piled high in baskets--...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I feel like I can smell them...! 
I'm going to fill my lungs with this air...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Next is the power pose. Apparently if you strike 
a confident pose, you actually become confident.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Like this one, for example...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: And one like this...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, that's a good one!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep the poses coming~! 
--Hup!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Fifty-one... fifty-two... fifty-three... 
......

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
--...There. I've got it. 
My pulse when I'm relaxed.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ideally I'd be able to return to this condition 
whenever I need to.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
So I'm sharing the information with you too, Trainer. 
--Here.

I took the hand she held out 
and measured Win Variation's pulse.
(Thump, thump, thump...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If I ever lose my composure, I'd like you to remember it, 
so you can bring me back to this rhythm.

After that--the two of us went up to the empty rooftop, 
looked up at the blue sky, and steadied our breathing.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Through meditation, we face ourselves. 
Trainer, are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Then--... 
Place your awareness--... on your breathing--...

--...Eyes closed, breathing on, 
memories of Win Variation came one after another.

The heat I felt watching her run 
with her frustration as a springboard--... 
The joy when she signed with me--...

Facing all of it, I thought it again. 
I want to support the horsegirl called Win Variation 
as far as she goes--...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: --...How was it, Trainer?
choice_data_list: ...Yeah. I think I was able to look at myself again

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Same for me. All sorts of things 
crossed my mind while I meditated.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The most of all were... 
memories of you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. And thanks to that, 
I was given the courage to keep fighting.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Any feeling can be turned into strength... 
I was so glad when you taught me that.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
And while we were hunting for mental training methods together, 
it was fun, and reassuring...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
So... I think I'll be all right. 
Even if I sink into dark feelings from here on...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Someone who lights a warm fire in my heart 
and stays with me through any amount of effort--

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I have an ally that strong 
at my side--...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I might cause you all sorts of trouble, but... 
please keep looking after me from here on. 
Trainer.
choice_data_list: If there's something you want to do, just say so!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I might cause you all sorts of trouble, but... 
please keep looking after me from here on. 
Trainer.
choice_data_list: If there's something you want to do, just say so!

text_block_list.text:
After that, as if to hide their embarrassment, 
the two of them looked up at the sky again.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes! In that case, there's a method we haven't tried yet-- 
would you do it with me?

After that the two of them tried all sorts of mental training 
together: zazen, yoga and more.
